newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia computer firm Pennu plans capital rise.
newsitem.headline: Estonia computer firm Pennu plans capital rise.

text.p: Estonia's second largest computer company Pennu, quoted on the stock market, said on Tuesday it would ask shareholders for permission to boost its capital by 136,000 kroons to eight million kroons.
The shareholders meeting will take place on February 24, the company said in a statement. It said it wanted to boost its capital to get funds to continue its planned growth.

The company also said it would seek approval for investment house Baltic Cresco to handle the share issue. Baltic Cresco last year carried out a Pennu issue that was made for local and foreign investors.
Pennu in January announced a 1996 non-audited net profit of 4.5 million kroons and forecast a 3.5 million kroon profit for the first-half of 1997.
